# CoachTime

> CoachTime is a coaching app where a coach runs their whole business: a public
> booking page, session types and prices, availability, session-credit packages,
> payment rails, a roster, live video sessions with on-screen telestration, and
> session recaps.

The one thing to know: CoachTime is built to be set up and run by the coach's own
AI. A coach pastes a prompt into their AI, the AI reads the setup pack, interviews
the coach, and walks them through setup screen by screen.

## Setup

- [AI setup pack](/ai): the full instruction pack for a coach's AI. It interviews
  the coach (sport, services, prices, availability, roster) and guides CoachTime
  setup one screen at a time. Stage 1 is guide-only; the AI does not press buttons
  yet.

## Contact

- Support: in-app, You tab, Contact support.
